title: Robust, useful, but lacks one major feature I'd like.
text:
Robust, useful, but lacks one major feature I'd like.. While I've had ADHD all my life and had pretty noticeable symptoms, I was diagnosed with it only last year. Following that came lots of professional, life-changing help and advice. One of those was using a TIME TIMER to manage my time; it's been a daily routine since then. I use it at work and at home. I saw this offering for a watch version and thought, "Now I can take it with me on the go!"

There are three mods of the watch: regular watch, TIMER mode, and stopwatch. Of course, the TIME TIMER mode is the one I planned to use most. I like that there's a 60-minute option and one for longer sessions. You can save presets for each timer, but--and this is the big omission I'd like--you can save only one. Sure, the normal TIME TIMERS can't save presets, but the watch is different. I use the pomodoro technique where I assign 25-30 minutes for a task, then take a 5-minute break (this review is being written during one of those breaks), then reset. I use the 60-minute timer to save the 25-minute setting, but there's no option to save an additional preset. On my watch, you can save only one for both the 60-minute mode and the longer timer, not each. It's not a huge pain to set a 5-minute timer, but, considering how easy the normal TIMER is to use as well as the watch being able to save at least one preset, I'm not sure why there isn't an option to save more than one preset. It's so expensive for such a simple watch, too. It feels sturdy and that it can take a beating, but $85 MSRP? That's a bit much.

The clock is cool because it uses the timer display for the analog clock. I like that it vibrates too, so I can use it during quiet study sessions.

product_metadata.title: TIME TIMER Watch
features: TIME MANAGEMENT ON-THE-GO — The Time Timer watch is a tool for visual thinkers of all ages and abilities. Children, students, parents, teachers and professionals will be able to visualize time passing and be able to complete tasks, tests, and projects

SPECIAL NEEDS — The visual timer encourages organization and productivity for all ages, including those with autism, ADHD or other learning disabilities. The countdown timer visualizes time passing to anticipate transition between activities

THREE MODES — The watch has three modes. CLOCK mode is displayed as both analog and digital and using 12 or 24-hour format. ALARM mode serves as a reminder. TIMER mode can be customized and represents any time from 1-99 minutes

OPTIONAL AUDIBLE OR VIBRATE ALERT — The countdown clock provides an optional alarm feature that signals when a time interval ends, ideal for learning activities such as reading, cooking, studying, and working out

PRODUCT DETAILS — The soft silicone watch band's circumference is between 5.5 inch and 8.25 inch, and the watch face is 1.5 inch. Ideal for large wrists and adults. It requires a Type CR2032 battery, and when replaced it will automatically reset to the factory default settings
